description_excerpt: Job Description • Receive and review testing orders, SOP’s and instruction before conducting testing • Perform tests in a professional and safe manner; ensure that tests are carried out in accordance with testing orders, SOP and clients' instruction; record all raw data • Study and review test methods, SOP, client’s manuals and prepare the proper resources to ensure that jobs are conducted in compliance with required methods/ SOP/ manuals • Keep Team leader informed on daily basis or as required about the progress of the testing and report any problems identified when performing tests. •…
